name: The Room
source:
You wake up in a room full of strangers.
Why are you here?
What is your purpose?
Can you trust anyone?
It's up to you to decide!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=theroom.com&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你在一间挤满陌生人的房间里醒来。
你为什么会在这里？
你的目的是什么？
你能相信任何人吗？
一切由你决定！

（来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=theroom.com&hl=en]Google Play[/url]）
